name: Mapleleaf viburnum
desc: Mapleleaf viburnum (Viburnum acerifolium): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Viburnum acerifolium, the mapleleaf viburnum, maple-leaved arrowwood or dockmackie, is a species of Viburnum native to eastern North America.
